prompt: A surreal, minimalist illustration featuring two people running diagonally upward to the right on top of a giant red and white bullseye pattern, resembling the Target logo. One runner is a woman wearing formal business attire, high heels, and a white construction helmet. The other runner is a man dressed in a full-length, long-sleeved red industrial jumpsuit with a yellow construction helmet. They are captured mid-motion, running energetically and purposefully. The background is clean white, and the red concentric circles beneath them curve like a stylized hill. The overall aesthetic is graphic, bold, and symbolic--representing ambition, contrast, and collaboration between corporate and labor roles. --ar 9:16
